readerCopy.body: A familiar wound can make the present situation feel like proof that the old story is happening again. Chiron square the South Node can put pressure on the coping strategy you built after an earlier hurt. You may brace for rejection, hide the need, overwork, or interpret a small mistake through the memory of a much larger one. The feeling deserves respect, but it may be carrying old evidence into a new case. Respond to what happened today before giving the past the final word.
